// Pediatric Growth Monitoring — Prisma schema
// Primary keys are UUIDs (never exposed). Human-readable patientId is separate & immutable.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Sex {
  MALE
  FEMALE
}

enum Role {
  ADMIN
  STAFF
}

enum ReferenceSource {
  WHO
  IAP
}

enum GrowthIndicator {
  WEIGHT_FOR_AGE
  HEIGHT_FOR_AGE
  BMI_FOR_AGE
  WEIGHT_FOR_HEIGHT
  HEAD_CIRCUMFERENCE_FOR_AGE
}

model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  email        String    @unique
  name         String?
  passwordHash String
  role         Role      @default(STAFF)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt
  auditLogs    AuditLog[]
}

/// Parent login for growth records (userId or mobile + password).
model ParentAccount {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String   @unique
  mobile       String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  name         String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([mobile])
}

model Patient {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid()) // internal PK — never expose
  patientId       String   @unique // human-readable: ARJ202608121430-001
  name            String
  dateOfBirth     DateTime @db.Date
  sex             Sex
  birthWeightKg   Float?
  parentName      String
  mobileNumber    String
  email           String?
  address         String?
  photoUrl        String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  visits          Visit[]
  measurements    GrowthMeasurement[]
  vaccinations    VaccinationRecord[]
  milestones      DevelopmentalMilestone[]

  @@index([name])
  @@index([mobileNumber])
  @@index([dateOfBirth])
  @@index([patientId])
}

model Visit {
  id                  String   @id @default(uuid())
  patientId           String
  visitDate           DateTime @db.Date
  ageYears            Int
  ageMonths           Int
  ageDays             Int
  ageTotalMonths      Float // precise age in months for charting
  weightKg            Float
  heightCm            Float
  headCircumferenceCm Float?
  bmi                 Float
  notes               String?
  doctorAdvice        String?
  vaccinationStatus   String?
  nextVisitDue        DateTime? @db.Date
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime @updatedAt

  patient             Patient  @relation(fields: [patientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  measurements        GrowthMeasurement[]

  @@index([patientId, visitDate])
  @@index([nextVisitDue])
}

/// Snapshot of computed growth metrics for a visit (longitudinal; never overwritten)
model GrowthMeasurement {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  patientId             String
  visitId               String
  referenceSource       ReferenceSource
  referenceVersion      String
  weightForAgeZ         Float?
  weightForAgePercentile Float?
  heightForAgeZ         Float?
  heightForAgePercentile Float?
  bmiForAgeZ            Float?
  bmiForAgePercentile   Float?
  weightForHeightZ      Float?
  weightForHeightPercentile Float?
  hcForAgeZ             Float?
  hcForAgePercentile    Float?
  nutritionalStatus     String
  clinicalFlags         String[] // e.g. ["STUNTING", "UNDERWEIGHT"]
  growthVelocityKgPerMonth Float?
  expectedWeightKg      Float?
  expectedHeightCm      Float?
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())

  patient               Patient  @relation(fields: [patientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  visit                 Visit    @relation(fields: [visitId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([visitId])
  @@index([patientId])
}

/// Versioned WHO / IAP LMS reference metadata
model GrowthReferenceVersion {
  id          String          @id @default(uuid())
  source      ReferenceSource
  version     String          // e.g. "WHO-2006", "IAP-2015"
  name        String
  description String?
  ageMinMonths Float
  ageMaxMonths Float
  isActive    Boolean         @default(true)
  publishedAt DateTime?
  importedAt  DateTime        @default(now())
  lmsPoints   LmsDataPoint[]

  @@unique([source, version])
  @@index([source, isActive])
}

/// LMS (L, M, S) parameters keyed by age (or height for WFH) and sex
model LmsDataPoint {
  id            String          @id @default(uuid())
  versionId     String
  indicator     GrowthIndicator
  sex           Sex
  /// Age in months (or height in cm when indicator = WEIGHT_FOR_HEIGHT)
  xValue        Float
  L             Float
  M             Float
  S             Float
  /// Optional published percentiles for chart curves (P3, P15, P50, P85, P97)
  p3            Float?
  p15           Float?
  p50           Float?
  p85           Float?
  p97           Float?

  version       GrowthReferenceVersion @relation(fields: [versionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([versionId, indicator, sex, xValue])
  @@index([versionId, indicator, sex])
}

model VaccinationRecord {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  patientId    String
  vaccineName  String
  doseLabel    String?
  givenDate    DateTime? @db.Date
  dueDate      DateTime? @db.Date
  status       String   @default("DUE") // DUE | GIVEN | MISSED | SKIPPED
  notes        String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  patient      Patient  @relation(fields: [patientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([patientId])
}

model DevelopmentalMilestone {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  patientId      String
  domain         String   // MOTOR | LANGUAGE | SOCIAL | COGNITIVE
  milestoneName  String
  expectedAgeMonths Int
  achievedAt     DateTime? @db.Date
  status         String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING | ACHIEVED | DELAYED
  notes          String?
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  patient        Patient  @relation(fields: [patientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([patientId])
}

model PatientIdSequence {
  id        String   @id @default("global")
  /// Last used minute bucket key: YYYYMMDDHHmm
  bucketKey String
  sequence  Int      @default(0)
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String?
  action     String
  entityType String
  entityId   String?
  metadata   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  user       User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

/// Short-lived OTP for parent mobile verification (public growth access).
model OtpChallenge {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  mobile    String
  codeHash  String
  expiresAt DateTime
  attempts  Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([mobile, createdAt])
}
